title: Record activity shows no approvals: emit approval feed items from plugin-approvals so the one-line approval row appears (follow-up to #35602)
body:
repo:objectstack#5 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CZiaBg6rk7dpy1s9Me

Filing gate: ① the half of #35602 its PR cannot reach inside its file surface. Filed by area ux-3 on seat 5's ruling (B: keep the approval row host-supplied until a producer exists). Suggested grade: p2. ⛔ Not a claim; triage sets lane and grade.

## What is missing

PR #35708 (#35602) draws an approval in the record activity stream as one line with 「看审批」, through an optional host callback `onViewApprovals`. Nothing emits `approval` feed items today, so the row is reachable only from items a host supplies. A user looking at a record under approval sees no approval in its activity. Context only: objectui#5877, and the producer census pin `ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/renderers/__tests__/feedTypeProducerCensus-5877.test.ts`.

## Done when

- plugin-approvals emits an `approval` feed item for each approval step on the record it governs (submitted, approved, rejected, recalled), readable by the same users who can read the record's approvals.
- The record activity stream shows each as the one-line approval row from #35708.
- 「看审批」 opens the record's Approvals tab (the tab container from #35595); the host wires `onViewApprovals` in the same PR.
- The census pin moves `approval` from "no producer" to "produced", and a real-kernel test pins one item per step and no item for a reader without approval access.

Dedupe: issue search `approval feed item producer`, `approval activity timeline` → only #35602 (and the architecture card #25950, which rebuilds the approval UI and does not emit feed items).
